title: Self-Cooling Pet Mat, Waterproof Cat and Dog Sleeping Pad
bullets: Self-cooling design for a comfortable nap spot on warm days at home.
Waterproof, so wet paws and small spills are easier to clean up.
Made of cloth, a simple pad for many spots around the house.

Sleeping pad for the spots your pet already likes to rest.
description: Tired of your pet claiming the warmest spot in the house? Warm weather makes a cool place to nap a real priority, and this self-cooling mat gives your cat or dog a spot of their own. It is a sleeping pad made of cloth, with a waterproof finish, so wet paws and small spills are easier to clean up. It is made for both cats and dogs, which makes it a practical pick for a home with more than one kind of pet. Set it where your pet already likes to lie, and see whether they settle in. It is a simple, no-fuss addition to the spots you already use. This page does not list exact dimensions or a cooling temperature, so measure your space before you order.
